what.en: A typhoon is a giant storm that spins over the warm sea. It brings very strong winds and heavy rain.
what.fil: Ang bagyo ay napakalaking unos na umiikot sa ibabaw ng mainit na dagat. Nagdadala ito ng napakalakas na hangin at malakas na ulan.

signs.en: PAGASA raises Wind Signals on the news and radio. The sky gets dark, the wind gets stronger, and the rain gets heavier.
signs.fil: Nagtataas ang PAGASA ng Wind Signal sa balita at radyo. Dumidilim ang langit, lumalakas ang hangin, at lumalakas ang ulan.

before.en: Help your family pack a Go Bag, charge phones and flashlights, and bring loose things inside.
before.fil: Tulungan ang pamilya na maghanda ng Go Bag, mag-charge ng cellphone at flashlight, at ipasok ang mga gamit na nasa labas.

during.en: Stay indoors and away from windows. Listen to the radio, and leave right away if adults say to evacuate.
during.fil: Manatili sa loob ng bahay at lumayo sa bintana. Makinig sa radyo, at lumikas agad kapag sinabi ng nakatatanda.

after.en: Wait until adults say it's safe. Stay away from fallen wires, broken trees, and floodwater.
after.fil: Hintaying sabihin ng nakatatanda na ligtas na. Lumayo sa nahulog na kable, natumbang puno, at baha.

signoff.en: Remember: listen to the news and be ready before the storm comes!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: makinig sa balita at maging handa bago dumating ang bagyo!
